title: EXECUTIVE FUNCTIONS 1 - Workin

description: Executive Functions are a set of cognitive processes that allows to manage complex or unusual situations successfully. They regulate analysis, planning, control and coordination of the cognitive system, and control the activation and use of knowledge processes.It is widely believed that Executive Functions play a fundamental role in 'smart' behavior and that they can be trained and improved through specific exercises. Main executive functions are the acquisition and updating of Working Memory, Cognitive Flexibility and Behavioral Inhibition.The "Executive Functions" series of apps is dedicated to the exercise and improvement of these skills. The first app, which is presented here, is dedicated to 'Working Memory', and proposes many exercises to verify, improve and use the ability to remember, recall and discriminate in the short term some elements that can be images, colors, words, voices or combinations thereof.Each exercise/level is divided into two stages: during the first, a set of stimuli is presented which must be memorized. Then, in the second stage it is required to use, list and/or discriminate between the elements presented.At the end of each exercise the app shows the result obtained and assigns scores and evaluations taking into account the relative difficulty, the number of elements proposed, the time taken and so on."Executive Functions" contains over 200 "cards" and their names, written and recorded with a female and male voice. description: Overview在等待时正念呼吸🌸 Why We Created CalmWait Remember that feeling? After asking ChatGPT or Claude an important question, you stare at the screen for those few seconds, waiting. Your heart beats a little faster, your fingers tap the desk, and your mind starts to race: "Will it give me the answer I want?" "Will the quality be any good this time?" We've all felt this anxiety of waiting. As heavy AI users ourselves, we deeply understand that feeling of "I know I just need to wait, but I can't control my nerves." 💝 What CalmWait Does for You CalmWait isn't about changing the speed of AI; it's about changing your state of mind while you wait. While the AI is "thinking," why not take a moment to breathe with it? Mindful Breathing Guide: As the AI begins to generate its response, a gentle breathing guide starts, turning your wait into a short, meditative moment. Perfect Timing: The guide automatically ends once the AI has finished its response, never interrupting your reading flow—just like a thoughtful friend. ADHD-Friendly Reading: Feeling overwhelmed by long responses? A dedicated line-by-line reading mode helps you digest the information at your own pace. 🤗 Why It's Worth Installing Not because it's powerful, but because it understands you. We ask AI countless questions every day, and each wait is a small emotional ripple. Instead of letting that time slip away in anxiety, why not transform it into the calmest moment of your day? CalmWait acts as a gentle buffer between you and the AI. It won't change your workflow or add any extra steps. It's just a quiet reminder when you need it most: "Breathe. It's all going to be okay." 🌱 Who Is It For? You, who use AI tools frequently for work. You, who get anxious while waiting for responses. You, who wish to integrate mindfulness into your daily routine. Our ADHD friends who want a better, less overwhelming reading experience. You, who believe that "slowing down is the best way to move forward." 💭 A Final Thought We live in a world that's moving faster and faster, where even a few seconds waiting for an AI feels like an eternity. But perhaps this is precisely when we most need to learn to slow down. CalmWait isn't a perfect product. It's a simple attempt to create a few moments for you to take a deep breath during your busy day. It may sound simple, but sometimes, the simplest things are the most precious. Install CalmWait, and turn waiting into a gentle practice. Works with Major AI Platforms: Whether you're using ChatGPT, Claude, or other popular AI chat tools, CalmWait integrates seamlessly to provide a consistent, calming experience. Our Promise: Completely free, with a deep respect for your privacy, and absolutely no ads.

description: OverviewSticky-note calendar for executive function planning. Drag steps to days. Syncs to Google Calendar.Built for students with executive function challenges — and the parents, therapists, and educators who support them. It's the digital version of the sticky-note method Sarah Ward and Kristen Jacobsen have been teaching for years through Cognitive Connections. HOW IT WORKS ✏️ Click "+ New sticky" and brainstorm every step of a project. They land in a "STOP and See the Steps" parking lot at the top. 📅 Drag each step onto a day on the calendar. Set a deadline so you can plan backwards from the due date. ⏱️ Mini analog clocks show the volume of time each step needs — making time visible the way Sarah teaches. 🔄 Drag stickies to a new day if plans change. Forward moves count as PUSHED — procrastination made visible. Moving earlier is celebrated as a self-correction. ✅ Tick off completed steps. Confetti when a project is done. 🎨 Color-code multiple projects (Latin test = blue, History project = pink) and see each project's progress at a glance. WORKS WITH GOOGLE CALENDAR Every sticky and deadline saves as a real Google Calendar event — visible on your phone, computer, anywhere you already use Google Calendar.
